entry.title: New: geml#integrations/dsh-plugin
entry.summary: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a Markdown or GEML document instead of the whole file. Ships the GEML authoring skill and a code-graph skill that builds and navigates a project call graph as GEML codemaps. Exact install spec: @geml/dsh-plugin. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
